definitions: To marry a man after he has impregnated a woman, thereby legitimising the child and the relationship.
To force someone to act honourably or legally, especially in a situation where they might otherwise avoid their responsibilities.
examples: After she became pregnant, he knew he had to make an honest man of her.
The court order was designed to make an honest man of him regarding his debts.
She hoped he would make an honest man of her before the baby arrived.
